title: Cleanup: silence pre-existing stderr noise in the GUT run (non-failing)
description: Across the Vertical-Slice-2 milestone, multiple reviewers flagged recurring stderr SCRIPT ERROR noise that does NOT fail any test (suite stays green, exit 0) but makes the headless run look unclean and could mask a real future error. Capture and silence these: (1) GUT 9.4.0 `signal_watcher.gd:159` / `diff_tool.gd:89` errors triggered by `assert_signal_emitted_with_parameters(...)` passing a typed Object param (transition_requested(from: EstadoBase, ...)) — appears in test/test_charger_states.gd and test/test_player_damage_feedback.gd. Fix: assert with `assert_signal_emitted(...)` plus a separate equality check on just the non-Object param (e.g. the target string), or pin/patch GUT. (2) `test/test_reticle.gd` logs 'Trying to assign value of type \'\' to a variable of type magic_manager.gd' from player.gd:52 — the typed `@onready var _magic: MagicManager` can't bind a duck-typed FakeMagicManager named 'MagicManager'. Fix: make the fake extend MagicManager, or loosen the test injection. (3) A `SCRIPT ERROR: Trying to assign value of type 'Nil' to a variable of type 'bool'` from the drone FSM/target-resolution path (surfaces when live enemy scenes tick, e.g. instancing levels/encounter.tscn or in player-instantiating tests) — track down the bool assignment reading a Nil (likely a drone/charger state or player onready) and guard it. None of these fail tests today; this ticket is hygiene so 'loads clean' is literally true. Tests-first not strictly required (no behavior change); ensure the full GUT run stays green exit 0 AND emits no SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error / Ignoring script lines afterward. Follow Bash gotcha (never 'cd &&'; absolute --path).
acceptance_criteria: The GUT typed-signal assert noise (signal_watcher/diff_tool) from test_charger_states.gd and test_player_damage_feedback.gd is eliminated (reworked asserts or pinned/patched GUT) without losing the transition/parameter coverage.
test_reticle.gd no longer logs the typed-@onready magic_manager assignment error (fake extends MagicManager or injection loosened).
The drone-FSM 'Nil to bool' stderr error is traced and guarded so live enemy scenes (e.g. encounter.tscn) and player-instantiating tests run without it.
Full GUT suite stays green exit 0 with NO SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error / Ignoring script lines in the output; project loads clean headless.
